description: This file defines a React functional component `OrganizationInfoView` which manages viewing and editing organization details, including members, settings, and permissions within a web application's frontend. It includes UI components, state management, and API calls related to organization data.

methods.name: fetchOrgInfo
methods.description: Fetches organization info from backend API and sets component state.

methods.name: handleMemberAdd
methods.description: Handles adding a new member to the organization via API call.

methods.name: handleMemberUpdate
methods.description: Handles updating an existing member in the organization.

methods.name: handleOrgUpdate
methods.description: Handles updating organization settings via API.

methods.name: copyToClipboard
methods.description: Copies supplied text to clipboard and updates UI to show copy success.
